name: San Pablo Youth Commission (SPYC)
org: City of San Pablo Youth, School, and Community Partnerships
what_you_do: Speak up for youth in San Pablo and learn how local government works. The commission builds youth leaders and works to improve chances for young people in the city.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 19. The application says you must live or go to school in San Pablo, or want to serve the San Pablo community.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The page says the city is taking online applications now. The application says it takes them year-round.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Commission Application, an online form linked on the program page. Contact the city with questions.
notes: Meetings are on the third Thursday of each month, 5:00 to 6:00 PM, in person at the San Pablo Community Center, 2450 Road 20. The application says City Hall, so check first. On April 17, 2023, the City Council approved an amendment to the commission bylaws.
